reason: Test-only repair of Butler suites left red on main after the async storage conversion (#939, 831d0d0) and the 60% compaction target (6509bd4). The tests now await Core's async Butler, work, goal, queue, settings, workspace and automation-policy APIs; helpers, stubs and listeners Core now awaits are async; asyncio.run inside the running loop is replaced with await; a fabricated active harness entry is removed before teardown shutdown; the synchronous provider-usage observer schedules its read like the real credit scheduler; setup tests read status once before refreshing because the fixture skips the lifespan that starts detection; the recovery matrix gives its local model a configured context window. Selected: every test in the 12 fully green touched files, plus the passing node ids in test_butler_authority, test_butler_host_load, test_butler_setup_controls and test_butler_tool_failures. No product code changed.
exclusions: Still red in touched files, not selected: (1) test_butler_authority.py: test_watch_cannot_act_and_steer_delivers_once_to_parent_main_agent, test_plan_change_steer_needs_explicit_reviewed_reason_before_parent_message, test_delegate_plan_force_requires_grant_and_current_reviewed_goal_evidence, test_plan_reassessment_re_reviews_when_precedent_changes, test_delegate_requires_explicit_pause_grant_and_pauses_main_goal, test_revoke_and_regrant_during_dispatch_cannot_use_old_event, test_changed_precedent_cancels_undelivered_action_and_requests_fresh_review, test_memory_lookup_failure_keeps_action_planned_and_retryable, test_attention_re_review_keeps_agent_claim_unverified_and_parent_only, test_interrupted_dispatch_without_queue_receipt_stays_uncertain, and test_butler_tool_failures.py::test_three_exact_failures_create_one_concern_and_steer_only_the_parent: class a with a latent class b product bug (butler_authority.py:522/826/835/879 call async methods without await), left unchanged for a follow-up after claude/unawaited-butler-authority merges. (2) test_butler_setup_controls.py: test_butler_preparation_binds_omitted_and_null_project_to_selection[None] and [body1], test_butler_setup_failure_retry_exact_cancel_and_readiness_are_authoritative, test_butler_retry_does_not_inherit_foreign_project_and_cannot_cancel_it, test_butler_shared_automation_prepare_reads_actual_cached_metadata: class a, test side repaired here, but the shared UI fixture ui/tests/fixtures/butler_setup_core.py:56 calls the async RuntimePlatform.resolve_human_terminal_profile without await (unawaited-coroutine RuntimeWarning under CI's -W error, no ready image); test_butler_reads_only_existing_selected_project_terminal_egress: class a, ui/tests/fixtures/terminal_core.py:128 defines resolve_human_terminal_profile as sync while container_terminal.py:2154 awaits it; ui/ is outside this test-only change. Pre-existing race, not changed here: test_butler_host_load.py::test_expired_host_sample_refresh_runs_off_loop_and_is_shared assumes all eight concurrent host_load reads reach the shared refresh within one HTTP round trip; in a long single-process run a late read starts a second sample (assert 2 == 1). It failed the same way on clean main in both CI-style runs (3.12 and 3.11) and intermittently on this branch (2 of 7), and passes in isolation. Untouched assigned files: test_butler_capabilities.py::test_global_chat_settings_read_runs_outside_event_loop asserts an off-loop thread that #939 deliberately removed (needs an owner decision, not an assertion deletion); test_butler_instructions.py::test_global_check_uses_saved_butler_harness_effort stubs analyze_structured, which #945 (99bb2e0) replaced with an investigation chat (create_session/prepare_chat/stream_turn), so a faithful repair is a rewrite. No UI, native or Playwright cases: only Python tests changed. No PostgreSQL-gated file is selected.
